situations.title: 복강경 장비 세팅
situations.tagline: Let's set up the laparoscopic tower and check everything before we start.
keyPhrases: Let's set up the laparoscopic tower.
Monitor, light source, and insufflator are on.
I'll confirm everything's working before draping.

situations.title: 기복 CO2 준비
situations.tagline: Let's get the CO2 insufflator ready for pneumoperitoneum.
situations.brief: 기복을 위한 CO2 주입 장치를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: The CO2 tank is full and connected.
Let's set the insufflation pressure limit.
I'll confirm flow before insufflation.

situations.title: 카메라·광원 준비
situations.tagline: Let's white-balance the camera and check the light source.
keyPhrases: Let's white-balance the camera.
The light source is at the right intensity.
I'll defog the lens before insertion.

situations.title: 로봇 도킹 준비
situations.tagline: Let's position the robot and get ready to dock the arms.
keyPhrases: Let's bring the robot into position.
We'll dock the arms to the trocars.
I'll confirm the cart is aligned.

situations.title: 트로카 준비
situations.tagline: Let's have the trocars ready in the sizes the surgeon wants.
keyPhrases: Which trocar sizes do you want first?
I have 5-millimeter and 12-millimeter ready.
Let's confirm the ports before insertion.

situations.title: 체위 조정 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm the patient's position and padding before we prep.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the positioning and padding.
Are all pressure points protected?
The patient is secured to the table.

situations.title: 기복 압력 감시
situations.tagline: Let's keep an eye on the insufflation pressure as the case goes on.
situations.brief: 기복 중 복강 내 압력을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: The insufflation pressure is at 15.
Let's not let it climb too high.
Tell me if the abdomen gets too tense.

situations.title: CO2 흡수 EtCO2 상승
situations.tagline: The EtCO2 is climbing from CO2 absorption—let's adjust ventilation.
situations.brief: CO2 흡수로 인한 EtCO2 상승에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The EtCO2 is rising as we absorb CO2.
Let's increase minute ventilation.
We may need to lower the insufflation pressure.

situations.title: 로봇팔 충돌 방지
situations.tagline: Let's reposition so the robot arms don't collide during the case.
keyPhrases: The arms are getting too close.
Let's space the ports and re-angle.
I'll adjust the arm position from the cart.

situations.title: 개복 전환 대비
situations.tagline: Let's keep the open tray ready in case we need to convert.
keyPhrases: Let's have the open set on standby.
We can convert quickly if needed.
I'll keep the laparotomy tray ready.

situations.title: 트렌델렌버그 순환 영향
situations.tagline: We've been in steep Trendelenburg a while—let's watch the patient's circulation.
situations.brief: 트렌델렌버그 체위가 순환에 미치는 영향을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: We're in steep Trendelenburg.
Watch the pressure and facial swelling.
Let's level the table periodically.

situations.title: 장비 고장 대응
situations.tagline: The insufflator just faulted—let's troubleshoot before the field is affected.
keyPhrases: The insufflator is showing an error.
Let's check the tubing and connections.
I'll grab the backup unit now.

situations.title: 렌즈 시야 관리
situations.tagline: The view's getting foggy—let's clean and defog the scope.
situations.brief: 렌즈 흐림을 관리해 수술 시야를 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: The scope is fogging up.
Let's warm and defog the lens.
I'll clean it and reinsert quickly.

situations.title: 로봇 응급 언도킹 준비
situations.tagline: Let's rehearse the emergency undocking steps so we're ready if we need them.
keyPhrases: Let's review the emergency undocking steps.
Everyone knows their role if we need to convert.
I'll keep the release ready at the cart.

situations.title: 최소침습 검체 회수
situations.tagline: Let's get the retrieval bag ready to bring the specimen out intact.
keyPhrases: Let's use the retrieval bag for the specimen.
We'll bring it out through the port intact.
I'll confirm the specimen is complete.

situations.title: 기복 가스 색전
situations.tagline: The EtCO2 just crashed with hypotension—suspect gas embolism, stop insufflation now.
situations.brief: 기복 가스로 인한 가스 색전에 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop insufflation and release the pneumoperitoneum.
Sudden drop in EtCO2 with hypotension—suspect gas embolism.
Left lateral, head down, and 100% oxygen.

situations.title: 트로카 혈관 손상
situations.tagline: There's sudden bleeding from the trocar site—we may have a vascular injury.
situations.brief: 트로카에 의한 혈관 손상에 긴급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: There's brisk bleeding at the trocar.
Suspect a major vessel injury.
Let's prep for open conversion and call for help.

situations.title: 긴급 개복 전환
situations.tagline: We're converting to open right now—let's get the laparotomy set open fast.
keyPhrases: We're converting to open now.
Open the laparotomy tray immediately.
Let's get another set of hands in the room.

situations.title: 로봇 고장 긴급 언도킹
situations.tagline: The robot's frozen and the patient's unstable—we need to undock and go open now.
situations.brief: 로봇 고장 시 긴급 언도킹으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The robot has faulted and won't respond.
Let's emergency undock all arms now.
Prep for open conversion immediately.

situations.title: 피하기종 호흡 위기
situations.tagline: There's crepitus spreading up the chest and the airway pressures are rising—this is subcutaneous emphysema.
keyPhrases: There's crepitus up to the neck.
The airway pressures are climbing.
Let's release the pneumoperitoneum and support ventilation.

situations.title: 시야 상실 대량 출혈
situations.tagline: The field just filled with blood and we've lost visualization—we need to control this fast.
situations.brief: 시야 상실을 동반한 대량 출혈에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We've lost the view—the field is full of blood.
Let's apply pressure and prepare to convert.
Suction and get more units in the room.
